sections.title: CLI Bootstrap State Machine
sections.summary: Same-host caller bootstrap before any daemon request can run.
sections.commentary: This machine models `CliComposition::bootstrap()` plus `DaemonSupervisor::ensure_daemon_available_with_traceability()`. Every terminal is caller-visible and QA should be able to force each edge with connect misses, launch-lock contention, spawn failure, or successful connect.
notes: every terminal maps to a typed caller result

sections.title: Reachable Daemon Request Outcome State Machine
sections.summary: Command and doctor outcomes after bootstrap has already reached a live daemon.
sections.commentary: This machine models the current post-bootstrap split on `integrate/phase-Z`: doctor compares config and ATM roster when it can run, send requires an ATM roster member before harness resolution, and copied preexisting SQLite state may still fail schema initialization. These are reachable-daemon outcomes, not bootstrap outcomes.
notes: doctor visibility is explicit at each terminal

sections.title: Daemon Runtime Lifecycle State Machine
sections.summary: Legal daemon runtime ownership transitions after bootstrap reaches a live daemon.
sections.commentary: This machine models `RuntimeComposition::start()`, `RuntimeLifecycle`, and the fail-closed startup path in daemon composition. Every edge is a real event or guard in code, and every failure terminal is observable through a typed caller error from the active command.
notes: startup failure rolls back to stopped
no direct Running to Stopped success path
